correctness.rationale: The Hilbert function and perfect socle pairing force every noncentral graded multiplication block to have maximal rank; summing those ranks gives (m−1)^2. The unique exceptional block is a nonzero tridiagonal Toeplitz matrix of nullity at most one with continuant D_j=bD_{j−1}−acD_{j−2}. Its zero condition is characterized via distinct-root ratios that are m_0th roots of unity, plus the p|m repeated root. Frobenius-invariant inversion orbits yield [gcd(m_0,q−1)+gcd(m_0,q+1)]/2 and the necessary u=1 subtraction. Every allowed ratio parameter has precisely (q−1)^2 coefficient triples with ac!=0. Direct independent finite-field rank and recurrence code verified 464 (q,m) cases and small-dimensional full maps, without substituting experiments for proof.

originality.rationale: The submitted result is the complete characteristic-unrestricted finite-field rank enumerator of multiplication by ALL quadratic forms in an infinite monomial complete-intersection family. Existing Lefschetz papers study existence or linear-form loci, and the conic paper treats different dimensions/characteristic; published determinant identities supply a starting ingredient, not the explicit Frobenius-torus all-coefficient count. The close Numata determinant paper was only abstract-accessible and remains a residual overlap risk, not falsely certified as NOT_COVERING. Searches did not identify a prior rank-fiber enumeration; absence is not proof of novelty.

value.rationale: Counts every rank of a natural quadratic-multiplication operator on a canonical Gorenstein Artinian family uniformly for every finite field and exponent. A codimension-one Lefschetz-failure locus has explicit arithmetic point counts controlled by two Frobenius tori (orders q−1 and q+1), including characteristic-two repeated-root boundary. This is a motivated complete enumerative invariant rather than a recomputation of one sample or a formal renaming; broader implications are not asserted.
